skills.name: Master of Camouflage
skills.description:
Lesley enters the Camouflage state, gaining double Energy Regen, 40% extra Movement Speed, and 85 extra Physical Attack.
The state lasts 3s or until Lesley takes or deals damage. Enemies can detect Lesley's position through distortions of their surroundings.
skills.tips: Combine stealth with her passive's increased crit damage to launch a devastating opening on your enemies.

skills.name: Tactical Grenade
skills.description:
Lesley throws a tactical grenade in the target direction while jumping back slightly, dealing 150<font color='#D58E1F'>( +50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to enemies in a fan-shaped area and knocking them back.
Lesley can cast this skill during <font color='#404495'>(Ultimate Snipe)</font> to cancel the state and immediately fire a Fatal Bullet at the target. The attack is only triggered when there are unfired Fatal Bullets left.
skills.tips: Survival skill -- try saving it for when you need to escape.

skills.name: Ultimate Snipe
skills.description:
Lesley locks onto the target enemy hero and fires 4 Fatal Bullets in succession, each dealing <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> equal to 250<font color='#D58E1F'>( +80% Extra Physical Attack)</font> plus 5% of their lost HP and restoring 10 energy on hit. The Bullets can be blocked by other enemy heroes.
If this skill is interrupted, each remaining Bullet reduces the skill cooldown by 10%.
<font color='#404495'>(Passive)</font>: Lesley's Crit Chance is increased by 5%.
skills.tips: Use this skill to finish off enemies with low HP, and be sure to keep a safe distance.

skills.name: Lethal Shot
skills.description:
If Lesley doesn't take damage for 5s, her next Basic Attack gains extra range and 50% Crit Chance and deals 100<font color='#D58E1F'>( +100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#E5CB19'>(True Damage)</font> (20% extra damage against minions).
Each point of fixed Physical Penetration Lesley acquires is converted into 0.5% Crit Damage, but her base Crit Damage is reduced to 130%.
Lesley's Basic Attack restores 5 points of energy and her <font color='#404495'>(Lethal Shot)</font> doubles the amount of energy restored. The <font color='#404495'>(Lethal Shot)</font> effect will activate immediately after Lesley uses a skill.
skills.tips: Try your best to avoid taking damage and use her extreme long-range attacks to wear down enemies.

items.name: Berserker's Fury
items.des: Unique Passive - Doom: Critical strikes grant 5% extra Physical Attack for 2s.

items.name: Windtalker
items.des: Unique Passive - Typhoon: Every 5-2s (reduced by 0.2s for each Basic Attack), the next Basic Attack will hit up to 3 enemy units for 150-362 Magic Damage. (This attack can Crit and the damage increases to 200% against Minions.)

items.name: Blade of the Heptaseas
items.des: Unique Passive - Ambush: If no damage is taken or dealt within 5s (excluding from Minions or Creeps), the next Basic Attack will deal an additional 160 <1025 0.4> Physical Damage and slow the target by 40% for 1.5s.

items.name: Endless Battle
items.des: Unique Passive - Divine Justice: After casting a skill, the next Basic Attack within 3s deals 60% Physical Attack as extra True Damage (1.5s cooldown).

items.name: Blade of Despair
items.des: Unique Passive - Despair: Dealing damage to non-Minion enemies below 50% HP increases Physical Attack by 25% for 2s (takes effect before the damage is dealt).

builds.tips: This equipment set deviates somewhat from average marksman gear. First off, you should take a Berserker's Fury for core damage output, then go for three pieces of attack speed gear to make up for her innately slow attack speed. Endless Battle provides Lesley with balanced attributes, and based on the first few item choices, its unique passive -- Divine Justice will have a more noticeable effect. Lastly, grab a Blade of Despair, the ultimate physical attack item, to greatly increase her physical attack. This equipment set ensures that your basic attack damage is sufficient when skills are cooling down, but may provide slightly inadequate burst during the early to mid-game.
